title: —Mn.
html_source: “Mn” in the Hebrew alphabet is “Mem-Nun”, which is the beginning of “Mene Tekel Upharsim”, the writing on the wall interpreted by Daniel. (This is often spelled “Mem-Nun-Aleph”, but The translation of “Mene” is “numbered”, which has been interpreted as “your days are numbered”, or “This kingdom is no longer yours”. Could this be a vocalization by Molly of the position of Leopold within the marriage?

anchor.suffix: No. She did not want anything. He heard then a warm heavy sigh, softer, as she turned over and the loose brass quoits of the bedstead jingled. Must get those settled really. Pi
